Priya (AE): quick heads-up — VaultCorp is asking for an accelerated POC next week. Key blockers from their side: enforced SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), SCIM for 200k users with delta syncs, domain ownership proof for multiple domains, RBAC group->role mapping, and a requirement that tokens never leave their VPC (they might want Private). Also they asked how SCIM throttling would affect sync time and if Dedicated pricing changes.
Liam (SE): ok — which IdP? any specific SAML attributes or NameID formats?
Priya (AE): they use Okta and Azure AD. NameID = persistent for Okta, transient not allowed. They want group memberships in SAML attrs if possible.
Maya (Solutions Eng): we can support NameID persistent, and group attrs — recommend SAML assertion includes `groups` or `memberOf`. For Okta -> SCIM we usually map `groups` -> `roles` in the connector.
Liam (SE): for SCIM scale: 200k users delta syncs are fine but need bulk provisioning with batching and backoff. We should confirm whether VaultCorp expects full re-provision every night or incremental only.
Priya (AE): they said delta only but will run a full import initially.
Jordan (SRE): note on throttling — our SCIM endpoint default = 100 req/s for hosted. For large full imports we advise our SCIM bulk endpoint (paged) or offline CSV import into Dedicated/Private. If they require VPC-only, Private deployment avoids egress but SCIM rate limits still apply per instance.
Maya (Solutions Eng): quick example SCIM config snippet they've asked for.
Maya (Solutions Eng): ```json
{
  "scim": {
    "bulk_page_size": 500,
    "delta_window_seconds": 300,
    "rate_limit_policy": "adaptive"
  }
}
```
Priya (AE): perfect — they also asked about domain proofing for multiple domains (example: vault.example.com, corp.vault.example.com). How tight is our domain verification and who needs to own the TXT record?
Liam (SE): domain verification requires either DNS TXT or HTTPS file validation. The TXT must be writable by the domain owner — multiple domain entries supported. If they need delegated subdomain control, they can add TXT on the parent. We log both verification events for audit.
Jordan (SRE): also highlight RBAC: we support mapping SCIM groups -> role ARNs (our internal roles). For Private they can customize role definitions in the control plane and connect to their KMS. For Hosted, we provide managed RBAC with tenant-scoped roles.
Evan (Pricing): pricing signal — large SCIM imports and Dedicated/Private options change cost. For Dedicated: baseline reserved capacity pricing + additional support engineering item for initial bulk import. For Private: one-time license + setup + monthly infra. I can run a quick quote once we know expected steady-state API qps and storage.
Priya (AE): they asked about SAML failover behaviors — if IdP is down what happens? they want deterministic behavior for user login vs service-to-service.
Liam (SE): we support SAML session expiration and fallback to email magic-link only for hosted with SSO bypass policies (requires admin enable). For Private, you can set alternate auth method in the control plane. Recommend document a fallback runbook.
Redwood Deploy Bot: [deploy-check] Capacity check for region us-east-1: Dedicated pool (g4dn-like) available; Private appliance image size 18.2GB; estimated provisioning time 3h.
Maya (Solutions Eng): operational note — for the POC, propose: (1) initial full SCIM import via our bulk endpoint (we'll coordinate throttling windows), (2) configure SAML with persistent NameID and groups attr, (3) domain TXT verification for listed domains, (4) map 4 core groups -> roles for RBAC, (5) if VPC required -> Private trial image.
Priya (AE): timeline request from VaultCorp: start Tuesday, 3-day POC. Are we confident to spin a Private trial that quick?
Jordan (SRE): Private trial == can provision ephemeral Private in staging within ~6 hours if licenses & network peering info provided. Need their CIDR, DNS, and KMS details.
Evan (Pricing): I'll draft a POC quote: 3-day Private trial add-on, one-time setup engineering time, and a follow-up monthly estimate.
Priya (AE): thanks. Can someone confirm SCIM rate-limit safety for a full import of 200k users? want a short sentence I can send to the customer.
Liam (SE): short line for customer: "We support bulk SCIM imports and will coordinate a throttled import to safely provision 200k users; typical strategy is paged bulk writes at 400-500 users/page with exponential backoff — overall import time depends on CSV size and backoff but is usually completed within a maintenance window of a few hours to a day."
Priya (AE): perfect. Any security questionnaire flags we should preempt? they will send an infosec PDF.
Maya (Solutions Eng): watch for data residency, KMS integration, audit log retention, SOC2 / ISO cert proof, and SCIM attribute minimization. For Private we can offer HSM-backed KMS and audit exports.
Priya (AE): great — next actions: Evan to send POC quote, Jordan to confirm provisioning checklist, Maya & Liam to prep SAML + SCIM config template, I'll schedule kickoff with VaultCorp. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Liam (SE): I'll post the SAML assertion example and a short checklist in this thread by EOD.
Jordan (SRE): I'll DM priya for network details.
Redwood Deploy Bot: [ticket] Created ticket INF-4421 for VaultCorp POC provisioning.
